verdict.rationale: Airwallex Transfers and Batch Transfers support sending funds globally to suppliers, employees, and beneficiaries in multiple currencies, with Transactional FX offering either best market rate or guaranteed rate for transparency, plus no international transaction/FX fees on cards. Docs cover global accounts, batch payroll/supplier payments, and rate guarantees, giving a strong end-to-end story for a finance lead. missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of actual fee transparency in practice, and explicit fee-schedule documentation beyond marketing claims.
